# Godot 4.4.1 notices

Unmodified upstream notices for the pinned engine used by the desktop builds:

- `GODOT_LICENSE.txt`: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.4.1-stable/LICENSE.txt
- `GODOT_COPYRIGHT.txt`: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.4.1-stable/COPYRIGHT.txt

The build script includes both files alongside the game in each desktop archive.
These cover the engine and its listed dependencies, not the game's media assets.
See [Godot's license guidance](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/about/complying_with_licenses.html).
